Alex Morgan  
Tel Aviv, Israel | +972 54 123 4567 | alex.morgan@nexgen.com | linkedin.com/in/alex-morgan  
---  
**Professional Summary**  
Staff Full-Stack Developer with 10 years of expertise in building scalable, enterprise-grade systems for startups. Proven track record of driving architecture decisions, mentoring teams, and delivering measurable results through cloud-native solutions, microservices, and full-stack innovation. Specialize in Go, React, and TypeScript, with deep expertise in AWS, Kubernetes, and observability tools. Scaled infrastructure to 500k+ users while reducing operational costs by 40%.  

**Technical Skills**  
*Cloud & DevOps*: AWS (architecture ownership, cost optimization, CI/CD pipelines), GCP (hybrid cloud integration), Docker (containerization for microservices), GitHub Actions (automated testing, deployment), Kubernetes (orchestration for serverless workloads)  
*Data & Systems*: PostgreSQL (query optimization, sharding), Prometheus/Grafana (real-time monitoring, alerting)  
*Development*: Go (backend systems, mentoring), REST API design (enterprise-grade standards), React (frontend architecture), TypeScript (type-safe full-stack development)

**NexGen Solutions** | 2020–Present  
- Spearheaded serverless architecture for SaaS platform, scaling to 500k+ users while reducing cold start latency by 70% using AWS Lambda and DynamoDB.  
- Redesigned CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions, cutting deployment time by 50% and eliminating manual testing for 80% of features.  
- Led microservices refactoring in Go, improving system resilience and reducing downtime by 65% through circuit breakers and retries.  
- Built observability framework with Prometheus/Grafana, achieving 99.99% uptime via real-time metrics and proactive alerting.  
- Mentored 5+ engineers in TypeScript and React, driving adoption of type-safe patterns across 12+ frontend modules.  

*Senior Backend Engineer*  
**ScaleUp Labs** | 2017–2020  
- Optimized PostgreSQL queries, reducing average latency by 60% and increasing read throughput by 3x for 1M+ daily active users.  
- Architected Docker-based deployment for microservices, cutting infrastructure costs by 40% and enabling zero-downtime rollouts.  
- Designed REST API for internal tools, standardizing 15+ integrations across engineering and product teams.  
- Pioneered Kubernetes adoption for container orchestration, improving autoscaling efficiency by 50% during peak traffic.  

*Junior Developer*  
**TechStart Inc.** | 2015–2017

- Developed Python-based data processing pipelines, improving ETL performance by 45% and reducing storage costs by 30%.  
- Collaborated on CI/CD setup, automating 80% of testing workflows and reducing release cycles from weeks to days.

- **NexGen SaaS Platform**: Full-stack system using Go, React, and AWS Lambda, handling 500k+ users with 99.99% uptime.  
- **ScaleUp Data Pipeline**: Python/PostgreSQL-based ETL solution, processing 10M+ records daily with 99.95% accuracy.  
- **Open Source Contributions**: Maintained 3+ GitHub repositories with 5k+ stars, focusing on Go libraries for API validation and logging.
